figures.caption: Fig. 14. Practical deployment workflow for fleet-scale degradation state management. Low-rate diagnostic data from cells 𝑖= 1, … , 𝑁 are processed intermittently to identify the half-cell model parameter set 𝜽∗ 𝑖 via multi-objective optimization of the QV and dV/dQ responses. The fitted parameters are used to quantify the degradation modes, yielding component-level SOH metrics. For fleet deployment, parameter estimation for multiple cells can be performed independently and thus parallelized across cloud compute instances, while the resulting degradation states are stored as a time history {𝜽∗ 𝑖(𝑡)}. For on-board use, the optimizer is not executed in the BMS; instead, the latest calibrated state 𝜽∗ 𝑖 is deployed and evaluated in real time.
